findings.description: The bucket has no ACL or public access block configured and is explicitly commented as public, exposing potentially sensitive customer data (customer-master.xlsx) to anyone on the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects including a customer master file are stored unencrypted at rest.
No logging block is configured, preventing audit trail of access to this bucket which is publicly exposed and contains sensitive data.
Versioning is not enabled, so accidental or malicious deletion/overwrite of objects (including the sensitive customer file) cannot be recovered from.
A customer master data file is uploaded into a bucket that is publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing potentially sensitive customer information.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted.
No logging block configured, so access to sensitive financial data cannot be audited.
Versioning is not enabled, risking unrecoverable loss or tampering of financial records.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, leaving operational data stored unencrypted.
No logging block configured, preventing audit of access to this bucket's contents.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so data science datasets are stored unencrypted at rest.
